uses_tf_v1_provider.label: Juju provider v1+
uses_tf_v1_provider.description: Checks every Terraform module in the source repository, including bundles, tests, examples, and sibling charms. Juju or unclassified modules must explicitly require juju/juju versions 1.0 or newer; >= 1.0, ~> 1.0, and v1+ pins pass. Upper bounds are optional. Proven non-Juju utilities are excluded. Missing requirements or constraints allowing older versions fail; unreadable or empty constraints are insufficient data. No applicable modules is not applicable. Shared across charms in the same repository; does not certify layout or overall Terraform correctness.
